knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r include=FALSE}
require(tidyverse)
require(tigerstats)
davisdata <- read.csv(file="UCDavis.csv")
```
## Our Goal is to answer this question Is there a difference between the alcohol consumed between the row

research question: Is there a difference between the alcohol consumed and the row you're seated in?

$H_0$: There isn't a difference between the amount of alcohol consumed and the row you're seated in.

$H_A$: There is a difference between the amount of alcohol consumed and the row you're seated in.

## you choose to sit in??

## Now with ggplot - first select the basic data

```{r}
basicCN <- ggplot(davisdata,aes(y=alcohol,x=Seat))
```
## Now add in boxplot

```{r}
basicCN + geom_boxplot()
```




 The students seated in the back row are more likely to consume more alcohol, students in the middle row consume a bit of alcohol and students in the front rarely consume a lot of alcohol.
  


## Numerical Summarys 

```{r}
favstats(alcohol~Seat,data=davisdata)
```

## Inferential Tests

```{r}
model1 <- aov(alcohol~Seat,data=davisdata)
summary.aov(model1)
```
